patterns: how should i design this database
responses: Architecture depends on scale. If your data is highly relational and requires strict ACID compliance, go with PostgreSQL. If it's unstructured and rapidly scaling, consider MongoDB.
Start with a well-structured monolith. Prematurely splitting into microservices will create unnecessary DevOps overhead. Abstract your modules clearly so you can decouple later if needed.
